PIN AUDIT COURT COMPLETE — StoryAtlas consumer evidence only; no shared path edit, candidate, or landing.

Exact inputs:
- StoryAtlas base 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5
- proposed published storymodel4s pin 7385cf9379e59599d1e18370049ac73782844816
- Intaglio pin 596b398af380079e4b251535230d0bc03cd88c51
- no storyatlas4s.storymodel4s.build or other local-project override; the composite checkout itself resolves to exact 7385cf9.

Clean disposable court:
- compileAll exit 0
- checkAll plus app/fastLinkJS exit 0 under Corretto 20.0.2.1 with java.awt.headless=true
- 113 StoryAtlas tests: layout JVM 22, layout JS 26, Intaglio JVM 14, Intaglio JS 14, CLI 15, app 22; edition JVM/JS have no tests
- scalafmt checks, all JVM/JS compilation, and fastLinkJS green
- without an explicit headless JVM, the AWT suite process exits 134 on installed Java 20/22/25; the exact AwtMeasurer suite passes 3/3 headless. This is a declared local runtime condition, not hidden green evidence.

Old-pin versus new-pin WOG editions:
- both produce the same 26 artifacts plus receipt
- all 11 SVGs are byte-identical
- the 15 text/HTML artifacts differ only in the truthful compiler provenance line, 3cf704a -> 7385cf9
- source checksum, configuration checksums, layouts, identities, mark/name counts, and all remaining content are unchanged
- receipt changes only the pin/compiler fields and the derived checksums of artifacts containing that provenance line
This classifies 7385cf9 as a compatible dependency refresh for the existing StoryAtlas contract, not a provider-output migration.

Live state rechecked: remote main and origin/main are still 7385cf9. Current local storymodel4s HEAD is a1a1db4, 75 commits beyond remote; StoryAtlas 3cf pin is 137 behind published and 212 behind local. Chief still needs to rule whether the consumer candidate targets published 7385 now or waits for a later reviewed/published main. I am releasing the audit claim after attaching this evidence; no build.sbt reservation is taken.
